description: Dear Friends, Earlier this week, Bellingham honored Juneteenth with a flag-raising ceremony at the City Hall flag plaza. This celebration, marking the end of slavery in the United States, holds special significance in our city. The official day of observance for Juneteenth in Bellingham was Wednesday, June 19, 2024, recognized
